## Summary
Greenfield build of **StockRoom**: a NestJS + Prisma/Postgres JWT-authenticated API and an Angular standalone-component SPA implementing item catalog, per-location stock levels, atomic IN/OUT/TRANSFER movements, low-stock reporting and a filterable movement audit log, containerised for the Colossus pipeline.

## Scope

### Files to modify
- `README.md` — replace stub with StockRoom overview, local dev + demo credentials.

### Files to create

**Root / deployment**
- `docker-compose.yml` — `db` (postgres:16-alpine, healthcheck), `backend`, `frontend`.
- `.env.example` — `DATABASE_URL`, `JWT_SECRET`, `JWT_EXPIRES_IN=24h`, `PORT`.
- `.gitignore`, `.dockerignore`.

**Backend (`backend/`)**
- `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `nest-cli.json`, `Dockerfile`, `docker-entrypoint.sh`
- `prisma/schema.prisma`, `prisma/seed.ts`
- `src/main.ts` — global prefix `api`, `ValidationPipe({whitelist,transform})`, CORS.
- `src/app.module.ts` — wires modules + global `JwtAuthGuard`, `RolesGuard`.
- `src/prisma/prisma.module.ts`, `prisma.service.ts`
- `src/common/decorators/public.decorator.ts`, `roles.decorator.ts`, `current-user.decorator.ts`
- `src/common/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts`, `roles.guard.ts`
- `src/common/filters/prisma-exception.filter.ts`
- `src/health/health.controller.ts` — public `/api/health`, `/api/health/deep`.
- `src/auth/` — `auth.module.ts`, `auth.controller.ts`, `auth.service.ts`, `jwt.strategy.ts`, `dto/{login,signup}.dto.ts`
- `src/items/` — module, controller, service, `dto/{create-item,update-item,query-items}.dto.ts`
- `src/locations/` — module, controller, service, `dto/{create,update}-location.dto.ts`
- `src/movements/` — module, controller, service, `dto/{create-movement,query-movements}.dto.ts`
- `src/reports/` — module, controller, service (low-stock)
- `test/*.e2e-spec.ts` — one file per spec Requirement.

**Frontend (`frontend/`)**
- `package.json`, `angular.json`, `tsconfig*.json`, `Dockerfile`, `nginx.conf`
- `src/index.html` (title "StockRoom"), `src/main.ts`, `src/styles.scss`
- `src/app/app.config.ts`, `app.routes.ts`, `app.component.ts`
- `src/app/core/auth.service.ts`, `auth.interceptor.ts`, `auth.guard.ts`, `manager.guard.ts`, `api-base.ts`
- `src/app/shared/models.ts`, `shared/error-banner.component.ts`
- `src/app/features/auth/login.component.ts`, `signup.component.ts`
- `src/app/features/items/item-list.component.ts`, `item-detail.component.ts`, `item-form.component.ts`, `items.service.ts`
- `src/app/features/locations/location-list.component.ts`, `location-form.component.ts`, `locations.service.ts`
- `src/app/features/movements/movement-form.component.ts`, `movement-log.component.ts`, `movements.service.ts`
- `src/app/features/reports/low-stock.component.ts`, `reports.service.ts`
- `e2e/smoke.spec.ts` — Playwright.

### Dependencies
- Backend: `@nestjs/{common,core,platform-express,config,jwt,passport}`, `passport`, `passport-jwt`, `@prisma/client`, `prisma`, `bcrypt`, `class-validator`, `class-transformer`; dev `jest`, `supertest`, `ts-node`.
- Frontend: `@angular/{core,common,router,forms,material,cdk}` v19, `rxjs`, `zone.js`; dev `@playwright/test`.
- Infra: `postgres:16-alpine`, `node:20-alpine`, `nginx:1.27-alpine`.

### Assumptions
- **Auth model = `full_auth`** (spec has non-admin actor `clerk`, no `## Auth` section → legacy default). Public routes: `/login`, `/signup`, `/api/health`, `/api/health/deep`. All others guarded.
- **First user is admin**: seed runs before any signup and creates `manager@demo` first, so the manager is user #1; subsequent signups default to `CLERK`. `manager` is the admin role.
- JWT (spec: "JWT auth"), HS256, 24h expiry, stored in `localStorage`; logout clears it client-side.
- Duplicate SKU → **400 Bad Request** (spec: "validation error"), mapped from Prisma `P2002`.
- Low-stock predicate: `totalOnHand <= reorderAt` (spec: 12→7 with `reorderAt` 10 appears; 40 does not).
- `GET /api/movements` and `/api/reports/low-stock` are **MANAGER-only** (spec grants both to manager "additionally").
- Locations seeded as `Zone A/B/C` matching scenario names; `zone` = `A`/`B`/`C`.
- Delete of an Item/Location referenced by a Movement is refused (409) to preserve the audit log.
- Angular 19 standalone + signals, Angular Material, no NgModules.

## Implementation Plan

### Step 1: Repo scaffold and compose
**Files:** `docker-compose.yml`, `.env.example`, `.gitignore`, `.dockerignore`
**Change:** Three services. `db` with named volume + `pg_isready` healthcheck. `backend` `depends_on: db: {condition: service_healthy}`, `DATABASE_URL=postgresql://stockroom:stockroom@db:5432/stockroom`, port 3000. `frontend` port 80→8080, `depends_on: backend`.

### Step 2: Prisma schema
**File:** `backend/prisma/schema.prisma`
**Change:** `enum Role { CLERK MANAGER }`, `enum MovementType { IN OUT TRANSFER }`.
- `User(id String @id @default(cuid()), email String @unique, passwordHash, role Role @default(CLERK), createdAt)`
- `Item(id, sku String @unique, name, description String?, unit, reorderAt Int @default(0), createdAt, updatedAt)`
- `Location(id, name String @unique, zone, createdAt)`
- `StockLevel(id, itemId, locationId, qty Int @default(0))` with `@@unique([itemId, locationId])`, `@@index([itemId])`
- `Movement(id, type MovementType, itemId, fromLocId String?, toLocId String?, qty Int, note String?, userId, createdAt @default(now()))` with named relations `fromLoc`/`toLoc` to `Location`, `@@index([itemId, createdAt])`, `@@index([createdAt])`
Relations use `onDelete: Restrict` from Movement so audited rows can't be orphaned.

### Step 3: Prisma service + bootstrap
**Files:** `src/prisma/prisma.service.ts`, `src/main.ts`, `src/app.module.ts`
**Change:** `PrismaService extends PrismaClient implements OnModuleInit`. In `main.ts`: `app.setGlobalPrefix('api')`, global `ValidationPipe`, `PrismaExceptionFilter`, CORS from env. `AppModule` registers `ConfigModule.forRoot({isGlobal:true})` and `APP_GUARD` providers for `JwtAuthGuard` then `RolesGuard`.

### Step 4: Auth module
**Files:** `src/auth/*`, `src/common/{decorators,guards}/*`
**Change:**
- `@Public()` sets `IS_PUBLIC_KEY` metadata; `JwtAuthGuard extends AuthGuard('jwt')` returns `true` when reflector finds it, else 401.
- `@Roles(Role.MANAGER)`; `RolesGuard` compares `req.user.role`, throws 403.
- `JwtStrategy` validates payload `{sub, email, role}` and re-loads the user (401 if deleted).
- `AuthService.signup(dto)`: bcrypt cost 10; inside a transaction, `count()===0 ? MANAGER : CLERK`; unique-email violation → 400.
- `AuthService.login(dto)`: `bcrypt.compare`, else 401 `Invalid credentials`.
- Controller: `@Public() POST /api/auth/signup`, `@Public() POST /api/auth/login`, `GET /api/auth/me`, `POST /api/auth/logout` (204).

### Step 5: Items module
**Files:** `src/items/*`
**Change:**
- `POST /api/items` `@Roles(MANAGER)` — `CreateItemDto{ sku @IsString @Length(1,64), name, description? , unit, reorderAt @IsInt @Min(0) }`.
- `GET /api/items?q=&lowStock=` — any authed user; includes `stockLevels`, maps to `{...item, totalQty}`; `q` filters `sku`/`name` `contains, mode:'insensitive'`.
- `GET /api/items/:id` — item + `stockLevels: { include: { location: true } }` + `totalQty`; 404 if absent. Serves the per-location breakdown whose sum equals `totalQty`.
- `PATCH`/`DELETE /api/items/:id` `@Roles(MANAGER)`; delete blocked (409) if movements exist, otherwise cascades its `StockLevel` rows.

### Step 6: Locations module
**Files:** `src/locations/*`
**Change:** `GET /api/locations` for any authed user (needed to populate the movement form); `POST`/`PATCH`/`DELETE` `@Roles(MANAGER)`. `CreateLocationDto{ name, zone }`. Delete blocked if any `StockLevel.qty > 0` or movements reference it.

### Step 7: Movements — atomic balance mutation
**File:** `src/movements/movements.service.ts`
**Change:** `create(dto, user)` inside `prisma.$transaction(async tx => {...})`:
- Validate item + referenced locations exist (400 otherwise); `qty @IsInt @Min(1)`.
- `IN`: require `toLocId`; `tx.stockLevel.upsert({ where:{itemId_locationId}, create:{itemId,locationId,qty}, update:{ qty: { increment: qty } } })`.
- `OUT`: require `fromLocId`; guarded decrement —
  `const r = await tx.stockLevel.updateMany({ where:{ itemId, locationId: fromLocId, qty: { gte: qty } }, data:{ qty: { decrement: qty } } }); if (r.count === 0) throw new BadRequestException('Insufficient stock');`
  The `qty: { gte }` predicate is what makes over-draw rejection race-safe and leaves the stored balance untouched.
- `TRANSFER`: require both, reject `fromLocId === toLocId` (400); guarded decrement from source, then upsert-increment destination — total conserved.
- Then `tx.movement.create({ data: { ...dto, userId: user.id } })`; the balance write and audit write share one transaction, so neither can land alone.
**Endpoints:** `POST /api/movements` (any authed user); `GET /api/movements` `@Roles(MANAGER)` with `itemId`, `type`, `from`/`to` (`@IsDateISO8601`, mapped to `createdAt: { gte, lte }`), `page`/`pageSize` (default 25), ordered `createdAt desc`, including `user{email,role}`, `item{sku,name}`, `fromLoc`, `toLoc`.

### Step 8: Low-stock report
**File:** `src/reports/reports.service.ts`
**Change:** `GET /api/reports/low-stock` `@Roles(MANAGER)`. Load items with `stockLevels`, compute `totalQty = sum(qty)`, return those with `totalQty <= reorderAt`, sorted by `totalQty - reorderAt` ascending. Response rows: `{ id, sku, name, unit, reorderAt, totalQty, deficit }`.

### Step 9: Seed
**File:** `backend/prisma/seed.ts`
**Change:** Idempotent `upsert`s. Manager `manager@demo` / `Demo1234!` created **first** (so it is user #1 = admin), then `clerk@demo` / `Demo1234!`. Three locations `Zone A|B|C`. Eight items with varied `reorderAt`, e.g. `SKU-001 Hex Bolt M8 (unit: box, reorderAt 10)` … `SKU-008`. Seed `StockLevel` rows so at least two items sit at/below `reorderAt` (report non-empty on first load) and at least one item is stocked in two locations (exercises the breakdown), plus matching historical `Movement` rows so the audit log and its filters are non-empty.

### Step 10: Health + error mapping
**Files:** `src/health/health.controller.ts`, `src/common/filters/prisma-exception.filter.ts`
**Change:** `@Public() GET /api/health` → `{status:'ok'}`; `@Public() GET /api/health/deep` → runs `SELECT 1`, returns `{status, db}` or 503. Filter maps `P2002`→400 (`<field> already exists`), `P2025`→404, `P2003`→409.

### Step 11: Angular shell, auth core and routing
**Files:** `src/app/app.config.ts`, `app.routes.ts`, `app.component.ts`, `core/*`
**Change:**
- `app.config.ts`: `provideRouter(routes, withComponentInputBinding())`, `provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([authInterceptor]))`, `provideAnimationsAsync()`.
- `authInterceptor`: attaches `Authorization: Bearer`, and on 401 clears the token and routes to `/login`.
- `AuthService`: `user = signal<User|null>()`, `isManager = computed(...)`, `login/signup/logout/restore()`.
- `authGuard` (redirects to `/login?redirect=<url>`), `managerGuard` (redirects to `/items`).
- `app.component.ts`: Material toolbar rendering the literal text **StockRoom**, nav links, role-gated entries, user email + Logout; `<router-outlet/>`.
**Routes** — every navigable state is deep-linkable and carries `data.flow`:
```
'' → redirect '/items'
'login'                      flow:'auth.login'      (public)
'signup'                     flow:'auth.signup'     (public)
'items'                      flow:'items.list'      [authGuard]      ?q=&lowStock=&page=
'items/new'                  flow:'items.create'    [managerGuard]
'items/:id'                  flow:'items.detail'    [authGuard]      ?tab=breakdown|movements
'items/:id/edit'             flow:'items.edit'      [managerGuard]
'locations'                  flow:'locations.list'  [managerGuard]
'locations/new'              flow:'locations.create'[managerGuard]
'locations/:id/edit'         flow:'locations.edit'  [managerGuard]
'movements/new'              flow:'movements.create'[authGuard]      ?type=&itemId=&fromLocId=
'movements'                  flow:'movements.log'   [managerGuard]   ?itemId=&type=&from=&to=&page=
'reports/low-stock'          flow:'reports.lowStock'[managerGuard]
'**' → redirect '/items'
```
All list filters, the item-detail `?tab`, and the movement-form prefill bind bidirectionally to query params via `ActivatedRoute.queryParamMap` + `router.navigate({queryParams, queryParamsHandling:'merge'})`, so every view is restorable from its URL.

### Step 12: Auth screens (SMOKE_MARKER carrier)
**Files:** `features/auth/login.component.ts`, `signup.component.ts`
**Change:** Centered Material card. **The `<h1>` renders the literal visible text `StockRoom`** on both pages — the app root redirects here when unauthenticated, so this is what the Playwright oracle sees. Below it: reactive email/password form, inline error on 401/400, link between login and signup, and a visible demo-credentials hint (`manager@demo` / `clerk@demo` / `Demo1234!`). On success, store token, load `/auth/me`, navigate to `redirect` query param or `/items`.

### Step 13: Items screens
**Files:** `features/items/*`
**Change:** `item-list` — Material table with columns `sku, name, unit, reorderAt, totalQty`, a search box and a "Low stock only" toggle both bound to query params, a row-click to `/items/:id`, and a "New item" button visible only when `isManager()`. `item-detail` — header with sku/name/unit/reorderAt/totalQty; `?tab=breakdown` shows the per-location quantity table with a footer total asserting it equals `totalQty`; `?tab=movements` (manager only) embeds the log filtered to this item; buttons "Record movement" (→ `/movements/new?itemId=`), Edit/Delete for managers. `item-form` — one component for create and edit, reactive form, surfaces the 400 duplicate-SKU message against the `sku` control.

### Step 14: Locations screens
**Files:** `features/locations/*`
**Change:** Manager-only table of `name`/`zone` with create/edit/delete; `location-form` reactive create+edit. Delete shows the 409 reason when the location is in use.

### Step 15: Movement entry
**File:** `features/movements/movement-form.component.ts`
**Change:** Reactive form: `type` (IN/OUT/TRANSFER radio), `item` (autocomplete), `fromLoc` (shown for OUT/TRANSFER), `toLoc` (shown for IN/TRANSFER), `qty` (min 1), `note`. Form controls enable/disable reactively on `type`. Shows the selected item's current qty at the chosen source location as a hint. On submit, surfaces the server's 400 (`Insufficient stock`) inline without clearing the form; on success navigates to the item detail with a snackbar.

### Step 16: Audit log + low-stock report
**Files:** `features/movements/movement-log.component.ts`, `features/reports/low-stock.component.ts`
**Change:** Log — manager-only paginated table `createdAt, user.email, item.sku, type, qty, fromLoc, toLoc, note`, with item select + date-range pickers bound to query params. Report — table `sku, name, totalQty, reorderAt, deficit`, each row deep-linking to the item; empty-state message when nothing is low.

### Step 17: Dockerfiles and nginx
**Files:** `backend/Dockerfile`, `backend/docker-entrypoint.sh`, `frontend/Dockerfile`, `frontend/nginx.conf`
**Change:**
- Backend: multi-stage `node:20-alpine`; `npm ci` → `npx prisma generate` → `npm run build`; runtime stage copies `dist/`, `node_modules/`, `prisma/`. Entrypoint runs `npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma db seed` then `node dist/main.js`.
- Frontend: build stage `npm ci && npm run build`; runtime `nginx:1.27-alpine` with **`COPY --from=build /app/dist/stockroom/browser /usr/share/nginx/html`** — Angular 17+ nests output under `browser/`; the build stage runs `test -f dist/stockroom/browser/index.html` so a path drift fails the image build rather than shipping a blank page. `nginx.conf`: `try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html` SPA fallback plus `location /api/ { proxy_pass http://backend:3000; }` so the SPA and API are same-origin.

## Testing Strategy
- **Backend e2e (Jest + supertest, one spec file per Requirement)** — each spec scenario becomes a case: unauth call to every data endpoint → 401; clerk `POST /api/items` → 403; manager create item → 201 and present in list; duplicate `SKU-001` → 400 with item count unchanged; manager create location → appears in `GET /api/locations`; IN 50 into Zone A → balance 50 + a movement row naming the clerk/qty/type/timestamp; OUT 20 → 30; TRANSFER 10 → Zone A 20 / Zone B 10 with `totalQty` unchanged; OUT 10 against 5 on hand → 400 **and a re-read confirming the balance is still 5**; item stocked in two locations → breakdown sums to `totalQty`; `reorderAt` 10 with 12 then OUT 5 → present in low-stock; `reorderAt` 10 with 40 → absent; audit log filtered by `itemId` and by `from`/`to` returns only matching rows.
- **Concurrency test** — fire two simultaneous OUT movements each equal to the full balance; assert exactly one succeeds and the balance never goes negative.
- **Frontend Playwright smoke** — load `/` unauthenticated, assert the redirect to `/login` and that visible body text contains **StockRoom**; log in as clerk, record an IN movement, assert the new balance on item detail; log in as manager, assert `/locations`, `/movements` and `/reports/low-stock` render, and that a clerk session hitting those URLs is redirected away.
- **Deploy check** — `docker compose up --build`, then `GET /api/health/deep` → 200, and a browser load of `:8080` shows the login page.

## Risks
- **SMOKE_MARKER:** the oracle loads the root while unauthenticated, so "StockRoom" *must* be visible text on `/login` (Step 12), not only in the authed toolbar or `<title>`. This is the single highest-value assertion in the smoke test.
- **Angular output path:** `dist/<project>/browser` differs from pre-v17 `dist/<project>`. The `test -f` guard in Step 17 converts a silent blank-page deploy into a build failure.
- **Race conditions on stock:** any read-then-write balance update permits negative stock under concurrency. The guarded `updateMany` + `$transaction` in Step 7 is load-bearing; do not refactor it into a `findUnique` followed by `update`.
- **Seed vs. first-user-is-admin:** if a signup ever precedes the seed, user #1 becomes a manager unintentionally. The entrypoint runs the seed before the server accepts traffic; the seed's `upsert`s make repeated container restarts safe.
- **Low-stock computed in JS** over `items.include(stockLevels)` is fine at the seeded scale of 8 items but is O(items×locations); if the catalog grows, move it to a `$queryRaw` with `GROUP BY ... HAVING COALESCE(SUM(qty),0) <= "reorderAt"`.
- **Logout does not revoke the JWT** (no denylist); a stolen token remains valid for its 24h life.
- **Demo credentials are seeded into every environment** — acceptable for a demo-seeded single-tenant app, unacceptable if this ever holds real data.
